# Verification: parse Ronald's last amazon-order request and compare to current Amazon cart
import re
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='8456546003', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0])['access_token']
ronald_number='3546176171'
ronald_last = apis.phone.show_text_message(text_message_id=16796, access_token=phone_token)
print('last_message_text_sent_at', ronald_last['sent_at'])
msg = ronald_last['message']
print('last_message_excerpt', msg[:120].replace('\n',' | '))

# Parse bullet list items
items=[]
for line in msg.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    m=re.match(r'^-\s*(\d+)\s*X\s*(.+)$', line)
    if m:
        qty=int(m.group(1))
        name=m.group(2).strip()
        items.append({'qty':qty,'name':name})
print('parsed_items', items)

# Login amazon and get cart
amazon_password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='amazon'][0]
amazon_token = apis.amazon.login(username='jamie-solomon@gmail.com', password=amazon_password)['access_token']
cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
cart_items = cart.get('cart_items', [])
print('cart_total_cost', cart['total_cost'])
print('cart_items', [(ci['product_name'], ci['quantity']) for ci in cart_items])

# Compare by product_name exact match to parsed names (best-effort exact string match)
# We'll consider an item matching if cart product_name equals parsed name.
parsed_names_to_qty = {it['name']: it['qty'] for it in items}
matched = []
missing=[]
for name, qty in parsed_names_to_qty.items():
    in_cart = [ci for ci in cart_items if ci['product_name']==name]
    if in_cart:
        matched.append((name, qty, in_cart[0]['quantity'], 'exact_name_match'))
    else:
        missing.append((name, qty))

# Also report cart items not in parsed request
unexpected=[]
for ci in cart_items:
    if ci['product_name'] not in parsed_names_to_qty:
        unexpected.append((ci['product_name'], ci['quantity']))

print('matched', matched)
print('missing', missing)
print('unexpected', unexpected)
